newsitem.title: USA: Fuisz gets Soft Chew patent.
newsitem.headline: Fuisz gets Soft Chew patent.

text.p: Fuisz Technologies Ltd said Friday that it has been granted a U.S. patent for its Soft Chew tablet technology.
The company said the patent is one of a series of patents and pending patent applications protecting its Shearform technology that is incorporated into the Soft Chew tablet.
The first example of a product using the Soft Chew technology, to be launched by the company's Pangea unit later this summer, is a calcium supplement planned to be offered in three flavors.
Commercial production has already commenced in anticipation of the product launch.
Fuisz Technologies is engaged in the development and commercialization of a wide range of drug delivery and food applications.
